policy: Only complete measurement sets retained. Failed/incomplete set RAW selected only when metadata, summary and bench notes establish incomplete status. Legitimate rx_missing rows in complete sets are preserved. No classification by filename alone. All firmware, programs, small logs, metadata and other non-capture files are protected. Mixed ZIP is protected pending a separate redundancy verification.
